newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Singapore rubber futures market was closed on Monday for a holiday. It will reopen on Tuesday.
On Friday, December RSS3 settled at 126.75 U.S. cents a kg against Thursday's 126.50 cents. January settled at 127.75 cents from the previous 127.50 cents.
December RSS1 settled at 181.00 Singapore cents (US$1.29) from 180.75 cents. January RSS1 settled at 184.25 cents (US$1.31) against the previous day's 184.00 cents.
December TSR20 settled at 176.25 Singapore cents (US$1.26) from 176.00 cents and January TSR20 settled at 179.00 cents (US$1.28) from 178.75 cents.
